description: Figure 8 consists of four pie charts illustrating the distribution of language model answer refusal categories on FACTBENCH across four different models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The figure does not include a separate legend; instead, each slice contains an internal label detailing the category name, raw count, and exact percentage. No slices are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding. The top-left chart for GPT4-o contains two slices: "Lack of Knowledge" in red (5, 83.3%) and "Safety" in orange (1, 16.7%). The top-right chart for Gemini1.5-Pro displays five slices: "Misinformation" in orange (33, 38.4%), "Lack of Knowledge" in dark blue (19, 22.1%), "Ethical Advice" in light blue (14, 16.3%), "Clarification" in yellow (12, 14.0%), and "Safety" in red (8, 9.3%). The bottom-left chart for Llama3.1-70B-Instruct features two slices: "Lack of Knowledge" in orange (3, 75.0%) and "Clarification" in red (1, 25.0%). Finally, the bottom-right chart for Llama3.1-405B-Instruct is divided into two equal slices: "Lack of Knowledge" in orange (2, 50.0%) and "Misinformation" in red (2, 50.0%).
